I recently hired Jim Williams Plumbing for a complete bathroom remodel at my mother's home, and I couldn't be more impressed with their service from start to finish. Brian and his team did an outstanding job installing a new bathtub, sink, and shower, demonstrating exceptional craftsmanship throughout the entire project.

What really sets them apart is their excellent communication. Brian is down-to-earth and easy to work with, always keeping us informed about the progress and any decisio

This is the second time I’ve used Jim Williams. First time was when my water heater broke and they came out the same day to fix it. Today, I’ve got a toilet issue and I made the call. Again, they’re able to come out the same day. Excellent work by Cliff and excellent customer service by Brian (and Cliff)! They have a client for life with me.
I had a leak. They came the next day and charged me a fair price. They were professional and polite. Thanks guys!

I called this morning at 8:30, and after describing the issue and based on the location of his other jobs throughout the day, Jim decided to come over after his current job.  The job was completed by 10:00 for a very fair price.  Good communication, good issue explanation, great timing and fair price is everything one can hope when they try a new plumber

We have been using Jim Williams Plumbing for our home plumbing needs for the past several years. Our phone calls are always answered during business hours or returned promptly. The guys doing the work are always on time, efficient, and respectful. They explain things clearly and answer our questions without judgment. We trust them so much that we referred them to my 74 year old mother, who has also been pleased with their service. Thank you Jim Williams for being a fantastic business to work wit

Replaced my faucet in the front yard since it was leaking. Job well done, but technician didn’t pick up trash after themselves. Once they started taking payment over the phone, I asked them for a photo. Their response was I don’t have time and can’t be waiting around.
Best & Quickest service! Excellent communication,  I have been renting for over 2 years and Jim is always so easy to work with! Highly Recommend!!
JWP was quick to respond to my request, showed up on time, was respectful of my property, and completed the requested work without fuss. Highly recommend.
Great Service! I highly recommend JWP. They were knowledgeable, proffesional & courteous!
Nice guy! Small owner-operated plumbing company in Arlington.
